scripts.build: npm run build -w @sea-battle/shared-types && npm run build -w @sea-battle/game-engine && npm run build -w @sea-battle/functions && npm run build -w @sea-battle/web
scripts.predev: npm run build -w @sea-battle/shared-types && npm run build -w @sea-battle/game-engine && npm run build -w @sea-battle/functions
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,emulators -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @sea-battle/web" "npm run emulators"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sea-battle/shared-types && npm run build -w @sea-battle/game-engine && npm run typecheck -w @sea-battle/functions && npm run typecheck -w @sea-battle/web
